kind: programmable Python MCP/coding-agent and workflow framework

runtime.execution: Asyncio provider/tool loop, MCP aggregation, local shell runtimes and separate detached POSIX durable process supervisors.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns agent/session/history, AgentCard instances and managed child processes; consumes model/MCP/external runtime services. Detached supervisors remain local owned computation, not general shared-fabric governance.

summary: Mutation-friendly turn hooks, typed workflow agents, live card/server reconfiguration and explicit archived compaction reconstruction.

inspection.scope: ToolRunner/provider delegation/local-MCP dispatch, shell profiles/durable lifetime, session/trajectory/archive reconstruction, reload path, evaluator workflow and direct test assertions
inspection.limits: No upstream code/tests run. Individual provider adapters/MCP servers/ACP internals not exhaustively inspected; claimed persistence scoped to actual records, not all transport or arbitrary external effects.

actions.name: list_tools / call_tool
actions.lifecycle: local then aggregator routing, awaited native callable or remote transport
actions.authority: native host/external service authority and explicit web-search permission boundary

actions.name: execute / bash / shell / exec; poll_process / process / terminate_process
actions.output: text output/status, managed or durable process handle
actions.lifecycle: foreground yield or background; persistent selects detached supervisor, bounded capture
actions.authority: configured local shell authority; aliases/profile shapes differ

actions.name: DurableProcessStore.create / launch / request_stop / link_session
actions.output: snapshot with spec/status/PIDs/capture counts and links
actions.lifecycle: create distinct launch, exclusive launch claim; durable stop/control record, detached supervision
actions.authority: private directories/capacity locking; environment inherited but not persisted

actions.name: resume_durable_processes
actions.lifecycle: reattaches existing linked process; never assumes command replay settles effects
actions.authority: runtime consumer with matching origin/fallback shell

actions.name: read_text_file / write_text_file / attach_media / read_skill
actions.output: contents/write result or staged model-compatible media/skill text
actions.lifecycle: await local handler; media staging influences next call
actions.authority: enabled filesystem/skill runtime, model media limits separate

actions.name: ToolRunnerHooks before_llm_call / after_llm_call / before_tool_call / after_tool_call / after_turn_complete
actions.lifecycle: await phase hooks on current iteration/once terminal
actions.authority: operator/program authored callbacks; low-level host access

actions.name: ParallelAgent.generate / EvaluatorOptimizerAgent.generate
actions.input: messages, request params, fanout/fanin or generator/evaluator and threshold/refinement cap
actions.output: aggregated or best-rated response; refinement history
actions.lifecycle: parallel gather then fanin; bounded actor-critic response loop
actions.authority: configured agents/models, no harness promotion implied

actions.name: compact_conversation / reconstruct_history
actions.output: summary/estimates/digest-linked archive then exact reconstructed messages/context boundary or error
actions.lifecycle: archive originals before replace when enabled; no tools summary side channel
actions.authority: explicitly configured persistence, strict path/digest/schema rejection

actions.name: reload_agents / _refresh_shared_instance
actions.lifecycle: rebuild impacted, shutdown old under instance lock; no refit barrier in traced body
actions.authority: operator/program card definitions and runtime-owned instances

actions.name: save_trajectory_record / session.save_history
actions.output: JSON invocation path or rotating history filename/metadata
actions.lifecycle: atomic file publication vs current/previous snapshot rotation
actions.authority: session directory owner; no universal raw transport archive

filesystem.detail: Model-facing read_text_file/write_text_file/attach_media local filesystem routing plus arbitrary registered MCP capabilities.

processes.detail: Profile-specific execute/bash/exec + poll/process/terminate; persistent background launches supervisor and returns durable handle; ownership/lifecycle explicit.

code_actions.detail: Native shell/local FunctionTools and external runtime permit ordinary computation; selected core no structured persistent notebook executor. Arbitrary local callables are host code.

persistent_kernel.detail: Persistent child shell can host computation outside main harness and be reattached, but this is surviving OS process not serialized interpreter/kernel state or multi-consumer service contract.

standing_database.detail: Session/trajectory/durable-record stores are standing structured files; MCP services could supply databases. No general queryable shared standing DB core inferred.

workflow_programming.detail: Composable parallel fanout/fanin and actor-critic refinement plus local callable tools/phase hooks. Workflow responses retained; no durable graph replay inferred.

multi_model.detail: Fanout/fanin/evaluator/generator are independent agent objects with provider steps; model-specific shell/tool profile selection.

live_collaboration.detail: Programmed subagent fanout/fanin and parent-child trajectory attribution; selected workflows lack peer mailbox/room protocol, so concurrent models alone do not establish live conversation.

concurrent_work.detail: Planned parallel call batches, fanout gather and separate persistent supervisor processes.

steering_interrupt.detail: Cancellation reconciles/resumes history and persistent process stop uses durable request; deliberate durable jobs survive runtime close. No claim external effects undone by history rollback.

turn_redefinition.detail: Low-level mutation-friendly before/after provider/tool/terminal hooks change history, request params and injected messages; actual two-step hook test checks injection and order.

compaction.detail: Summary side channel with no tools, retained complete tail/templates and explicit archives/digest; archive failure prevents replacement if persistence enabled.

context_repair.detail: Strict original reconstruction checks archive hash/path/schema and context replace boundary; hooks can reload context. This gives controlled primitives, not automatic semantic repair policy.

original_audit.detail: Compaction retains original history and summarizer request/response; stateless trajectories retain original/effective tool args. Output retention caps, snapshots and optional no-history mode prevent universal everything-audit claim.

audit_query.detail: Strict archive reconstruction/structured trajectory schema and process output records enable downstream study; complete database query facility over all raw events not traced.

hot_change.detail: Registry-version AgentCard instance rebuild/restore and dynamic local/MCP tool routing; refresh instance lock/shutdown is not explicit all-owned-work quiescence/default workflow-completion barrier.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Session restore plus durable supervisor reattachment preserves logical history and independently running local processes; active provider/task heaps not serialized; persistent work remains running rather than paused.

remote_services.detail: MCP aggregation and external runtime dispatcher consume services with request handlers; service governance not generally adopted by agent.

self_improvement.detail: Evaluator-optimizer refines generated answers until threshold/max, picks best response; hooks/tools could compose experiments but this is not harness self-research promotion.

complaints.detail: Trajectory IDs/parent call/effective args and cancellation/checkpoint records can underpin complaints; no traced external bead-table/state snapshot filing contract.

authority.detail: Local callables run host code; MCP/external/filesystem/shell route boundary and search permission distinct. Individual external service/ACP authorities not inferred from local tool dispatch.

evaluation.detail: Structured evaluator ratings/feedback drive bounded response refinement; archive/resume/hook tests have concrete structural lifecycle oracles, not semantics-quality proof.

time_order.detail: Exclusive record launch/stop/fsync, checkpoint locking, parent trajectory IDs and keyed tool results give local order; concurrent external calls no complete side-effect settlement journal.

evidence.claim: Iterator folds selected polling history, auto-compacts followup, discovers tools, before-LLM hook, provider step and after-LLM hook.
Tool-use/continue iteration checkpoints, canceled-turn rollback/persistence and terminal after-turn hook; cancellation does not transactionally undo external effects.
Low-level hooks explicitly permit history/load/request-parameter mutations and injected messages at loop boundaries.
Tool discovery/planning matches actual names, schedules parallel or sequential calls and keyed results/timings.
Local function executes FastMCP tool with invocation/progress context, converts native result and synthesizes error CallToolResult.
Routes external/filesystem/skill/shell/local handlers first then MCP aggregator; web search permission boundary explicit and human-input opt-in builtin.
Model/tool profiles expose execute/poll/terminate or bash/process or shell/exec aliases, separate capability settings.
Native persistent background shell path invokes durable launch and returns tracked status/handle, not an unused helper.
Private durable spec/record/capacity lock, command/cwd/origin session/agent and output retention; creation distinct from launch.
Launch claims process exactly once and starts detached supervisor inheriting environment without persisting it, separate session/fds.
Stop request published via exclusive hardlink, flush/fsync and directory fsync; status/capture records temp+replace+fsync.
Supervisor opens append capture streams and launches shell in its own process session with DEVNULL stdin, drains output through threads and retention limits.
Stop/cleanup sends group TERM then group KILL, including remaining descendants after direct child ends.
Resumed session discovers/deduplicates matching linked active records; attaches original-agent/fallback shell; reports unavailable/unattached rather than recreating commands.
Close terminates session processes but detaches durable ones, explicitly reports remaining handles; not refit pause/quiescence.
No-tool side-channel summary, failure leaves history; archive must succeed when persistence enabled, digest-linked metadata retains summary request/response, then installs templates+summary+tail.
Strict archive validator checks every message, digest/path/symlink and unique checkpoint; reconstruction inserts model-context boundary instead of replaying retained tail as new effects.

Stateless invocation records original/effective args, rendered child input, messages/model/usage and parent-call IDs, atomic temp rename; source says future append-only stream, not current universal journal.
Exclusive checkpoint lock, history current/previous rotation and session metadata update; conversational snapshots rather than complete append-only core audit.
Registry-version refresh rebuilds impacted instances under instance lock, shuts old agents, finalizes new and restores session; no all-work drain shown in this refresh body.
Fanout child generation via asyncio.gather, telemetry; subsequent fanin separate agent/model.
Evaluator response rating/needs-improvement determines refinement/threshold/max; returns best response, not modified harness or deployment.
Exact fail-archive unchanged history, persistence-disabled reconstruction rejection, unique archive/no-overwrite collision and partial-write cleanup oracle.
Resume assertion routes active linked process to original worker, classifies stale/unavailable and leaves main unattached.

tests.focus: original archive preservation, reconstruction and summarizer accounting
tests.oracle: Fake model summary tests reconstruct exact original messages; compare summary_request and parsed response; injected archive/link/partial-write failures assert unchanged history/bytes/unique outputs. Does not test semantic summary fidelity.

Source fixtures create POSIX sleep process supervisors and stale records, assert original worker attachment and unavailable/unattached sets with close cleanup. Read only, not executed; it checks lifecycle classification, not arbitrary daemon effect settlement.
Fake LLM captures request messages; exact hook sequence and injected text assertion prove actual turn agency. No provider-live or refit guarantee.

strengths: Mutable phase hooks and rich local/MCP routing expose real programmable turns.
Compaction archives preserve originals with digest-linked strict reconstruction and full summarizer request/response accounting.
Detached durable supervisor records and explicit session-vs-persistent lifetime are concrete restartable process-consumer mechanisms.
limits: Persistent supervisor keeps owned computation running at main shutdown; Arconaut refit policy requires pause/drain or true separate daemon ownership.
Trajectory files apply especially to stateless invocations; current/previous session snapshots and bounded process output are not universal original audit.
Response evaluator-optimizer and AgentCard refresh do not establish harness optimization or executable refit.
arconaut_questions: Can compaction archive/error discipline become normal audit/context repair with full raw originals beyond selected structured messages?
What external lifecycle contract distinguishes paused owned processes from independent shared daemon consumers at refit?
Which exact workflow/hook changes should activate after affected runs conclude, and what counts as safe forced interruption?
